meta.title: यह कैसे काम करता है
meta.description: एक प्रश्न उत्तर कैसे बनता है, स्रोतों को याद रखने के बजाय पुनर्प्राप्त क्यों किया जाता है, और सिस्टम कब उत्तर देने से मना करता है।

heading: एक प्रश्न उद्धृत उत्तर कैसे बनता है
standfirst: कोई प्रश्न स्रोत-सहित उत्तर कैसे बनता है, और सिस्टम अनुमान लगाने के बजाय कब उत्तर देने से मना करता है।

status.heading: वास्तव में क्या निर्मित है
status.body: हर उत्तर सत्यापित आधिकारिक स्रोतों से बनता है — स्रोत पृष्ठ पर सूचीबद्ध अधिनियम, नियम, दिशानिर्देश और सरकारी पोर्टल — और हर दावा अपने स्रोत से जुड़ा होता है।

pipeline.heading: प्रश्न के साथ क्या होता है
pipeline.standfirst: तेरह चरण। यह देखने के लिए किसी एक का चयन करें कि यह क्या करता है।

detect.name: भाषा पहचान
detect.does: (भाषा पहचान) Works out which of the six supported languages the question is in, with a confidence score.
detect.outputs: (भाषा पहचान) A language code and a confidence, both shown in the interface so the reader can correct them.
detect.fails: (भाषा पहचान) A wrong guess is visible and correctable rather than silent. Below a confidence floor it asks instead of guessing.

understand.name: प्रश्न समझ
understand.does: (प्रश्न समझ) Extracts what is being asked: intent, which rights are in play, which regulatory areas, hints about the product class, and named entities such as herbs, dosage forms and destination markets.
understand.outputs: (प्रश्न समझ) A structured query, plus a decision on whether the question can be answered at all without more facts.
understand.fails: (प्रश्न समझ) An ambiguous question routes to a clarifying question rather than to a confident answer about the wrong thing.

clarify.name: स्पष्टीकरण
clarify.does: (स्पष्टीकरण) Where the answer depends on what the product is regulatorily and that is not yet known, asks the single most decisive question rather than answering for every possibility.
clarify.outputs: (स्पष्टीकरण) Either a product class, or an explicit statement that the answer is conditional on it.
clarify.fails: (स्पष्टीकरण) If the reader declines to answer, the system says which way the answer would turn rather than picking one.

route.name: अधिकार क्षेत्र विभाजन
route.does: (अधिकार क्षेत्र विभाजन) Selects the namespace to search. India and International are separate indexes, and a single retrieval call reads one of them.
route.outputs: (अधिकार क्षेत्र विभाजन) A namespace, or two retrievals for a cross-border question.
route.fails: (अधिकार क्षेत्र विभाजन) There is no fallback that merges the two. A question that cannot be routed is asked which jurisdiction it means.

retrieve.name: पुनर्प्राप्ति
retrieve.does: (पुनर्प्राप्ति) Hybrid search over the selected namespace: keyword matching and dense vectors, fused. Metadata filters are applied before scoring — jurisdiction, effective date window, document type, product class and topic — so superseded text is never a candidate.
retrieve.outputs: (पुनर्प्राप्ति) A candidate set of passages with their scores and metadata.
retrieve.fails: (पुनर्प्राप्ति) Below a retrieval floor there is nothing to answer from, and the pipeline goes to abstention rather than to generation.

rerank.name: पुनः क्रमबद्ध करना
rerank.does: (पुनः क्रमबद्ध करना) A cross-encoder reads each candidate against the question and reorders them, cutting a broad candidate set down to the few that actually bear on it.
rerank.outputs: (पुनः क्रमबद्ध करना) A short ranked list, carrying both the retrieval score and the rerank score.
rerank.fails: (पुनः क्रमबद्ध करना) If nothing clears the rerank threshold, that is itself a signal, and confidence drops or the system abstains.

context.name: संदर्भ संयोजन
context.does: (संदर्भ संयोजन) Packs the chosen passages with their metadata headers — title, section path, version, effective date — so the model can attribute what it uses. The token budget is enforced with document diversity, so the window is never filled from a single document.
context.outputs: (संदर्भ संयोजन) A context block where every passage is addressable by id.
context.fails: (संदर्भ संयोजन) If diversity cannot be met, the answer is marked as resting on a single source, which caps its confidence.

generate.name: उत्तर निर्माण
generate.does: (उत्तर निर्माण) Answers from the provided passages and nothing else, under a prompt that forbids stating anything not present in them. Output is schema-constrained: the four blocks, plus a machine-readable map from each claim to the passages supporting it.
generate.outputs: (उत्तर निर्माण) Structured blocks and a claim-to-passage map, never prose to be parsed afterwards.
generate.fails: (उत्तर निर्माण) If the passages do not support an answer, the model is required to return an abstention object rather than its best guess.

map.name: उद्धरण मानचित्रण
map.does: (उद्धरण मानचित्रण) Checks every passage id the model returned against the passages actually supplied. Any claim whose citation does not verify is dropped.
map.outputs: (उद्धरण मानचित्रण) An answer where every marker resolves to a real retrieved passage.
map.fails: (उद्धरण मानचित्रण) If too many claims drop, the answer is downgraded or abstains. An uncited answer is never shown in place of a cited one.

confidence.name: विश्वास स्कोरिंग
confidence.does: (विश्वास स्कोरिंग) Computes high, moderate, low or abstain from the retrieval result — how many passages cleared the threshold, how many distinct documents they came from, whether they contradict each other, and whether they are all within their effective window.
confidence.outputs: (विश्वास स्कोरिंग) A level and a one-sentence reason, both shown.
confidence.fails: (विश्वास स्कोरिंग) Records never raise or lower it. Confidence is a property of the sources, not of how the answer reads.

abstain.name: परहेज जाँच
abstain.does: (परहेज जाँच) The last gate before an answer is shown. Decides whether the question was out of scope, whether the sources conflict, whether they are out of date, or whether nothing relevant was found.
abstain.outputs: (परहेज जाँच) Either an answer, or one of the abstention states below with what the reader is offered next.
abstain.fails: (परहेज जाँच) This is the stage that is allowed to fail loudly. Abstaining is a correct outcome, not an error.

translate.name: अनुवाद
translate.does: (अनुवाद) Translates the answer into the reader's language, behind an interface so the implementation can be swapped — including for national language infrastructure.
translate.outputs: (अनुवाद) A translated answer with untranslated citation metadata.
translate.fails: (अनुवाद) Source passages are never translated. A translated citation is no longer a citation, and a reader checking a source needs the words as published.

render.name: उत्तर प्रदर्शन
render.does: (उत्तर प्रदर्शन) Renders the four blocks with claim-level markers, the confidence and its reason, and the source cards behind them. Sentences resting on no passage are marked as general explanation.
render.outputs: What you see on the workspace.
render.fails: (उत्तर प्रदर्शन) If citation mapping produced nothing to show, this surface renders an abstention rather than an unsourced answer.

retrieval.heading: स्रोतों को याद रखने के बजाय पुनर्प्राप्त क्यों किया जाता है
retrieval.body1: A language model answering a legal question from training data answers from memory: undated, unattributed, and confidently wrong on anything amended since it was trained. It cannot tell you where it got something, because it does not know.
retrieval.body2: Retrieval constrains the answer to a curated, version-tracked set of published documents. Each claim points at the passage behind it, and every answer carries the date of the sources it used.
retrieval.body3: It reduces hallucination and localises it. It does not eliminate it: a model can still misread a passage, or state something the passage does not quite say. So every claim is checkable against the passage it names, sentences resting on nothing are marked, and the system abstains rather than produce something plausible.

abstention.heading: उत्तर देने से मना करना एक विशेषता है
abstention.standfirst: Most of the work in a product like this is in knowing when not to answer. These are the states, with what each one offers the reader next. The logic behind them is designed and not yet built; what you see here is the surface it will use.

nothing.title: Nothing relevant found
nothing.body: I couldn't find anything in these sources that answers this reliably.
nothing.offers: Rephrase, narrow the jurisdiction, name the product type, see what's covered, or send the question to a human with the context already filled in.

scope.title: Outside what this covers
scope.body: Outside what I can answer. I cover intellectual property and regulatory requirements for Ayurvedic products — not clinical advice, legal opinions, or predictions about whether an application will succeed.
scope.offers: A plain statement of what it can do instead, and the escalation route.

conflict.title: The sources disagree
conflict.body: Two passages point different ways, and the answer depends on which governs.
conflict.offers: Both passages, with their dates and their documents, so the reader can see the disagreement rather than being handed one side of it.

stale.title: The sources may be out of date
stale.body: What was found sits outside its effective window, or predates an amendment the corpus knows about.
stale.offers: The passage with its date shown, and a plain statement that the position may have changed.

facts.title: It depends on facts you have not given
facts.body: The answer turns on something only you know — usually what the product is regulatorily.
facts.offers: The single most decisive question, rather than a list of every possibility.

jurisdictions.heading: दो नामस्थान, कभी मिश्रित नहीं
jurisdictions.body: India and International are separate indexes. A retrieval call reads one; a cross-border question runs two and produces two answers rather than one blended paragraph. An answer mixing the Indian position with an export market's is wrong in a way that reads as right, and a reader could not tell which half applied to them.
jurisdictions.note: These two answers were produced separately and are shown side by side. Nothing in the product merges them, and no interface anywhere presents a single answer covering both.

architecture.heading: यह कैसे संयोजित है
architecture.standfirst: Layers, and what state each part is in. The retriever's metadata filters are listed because they are what makes superseded text unreachable rather than merely deprioritised.
architecture.filters: Jurisdiction · product class · IP right · regulatory area · effective date window · document type · language
architecture.notScheduledBody: A knowledge graph over entities and provisions, agentic orchestration across several sources, connectors to subscription databases. Directions, not commitments. None is being built.

evaluation.heading: इसे कैसे मापा जाता है
evaluation.standfirst: These are the axes it will be scored on. Two of them have a target of one hundred per cent, because a single failure on either is the kind that destroys trust in everything else.
evaluation.notRunBody: There is no corpus to retrieve from and no pipeline to score, so there are no numbers on this page. When the harness runs it will write a summary that this page reads, and whatever it says will appear here — including the bad numbers. A page of metric definitions with no results is less impressive than a table of figures, and considerably more honest.

answerAccuracy.name: उत्तर सटीकता
answerAccuracy.what: Whether the answer is right, judged against a reference answer and spot-checked by a person.
answerAccuracy.target: as high as the sources allow

citationCorrectness.name: उद्धरण शुद्धता
citationCorrectness.what: Whether the passage a claim cites actually supports that claim.

citationValidity.name: उद्धरण वैधता
citationValidity.what: (उद्धरण वैधता) Whether every citation resolves to a real, current passage.

abstentionPrecision.name: परहेज परिशुद्धता
abstentionPrecision.what: (परहेज परिशुद्धता) When it declines, whether it was right to.

abstentionRecall.name: परहेज रिकॉल
abstentionRecall.what: (परहेज रिकॉल) Whether it answers the questions it should answer, rather than declining defensively.

jurisdictionPurity.name: अधिकार क्षेत्र शुद्धता
jurisdictionPurity.what: (अधिकार क्षेत्र शुद्धता) Whether any answer mixes the Indian position with another jurisdiction's.

authorityPurity.name: प्राधिकार शुद्धता
authorityPurity.what: (प्राधिकार शुद्धता) Whether a filed or granted record ever appeared as a citation.

classificationAccuracy.name: वर्गीकरण सटीकता
classificationAccuracy.what: (वर्गीकरण सटीकता) Whether the product class the flow reaches is the right one.

multilingualQuality.name: बहुभाषी गुणवत्ता
multilingualQuality.what: Whether an answer in Telugu is as good as the same answer in English, judged by a speaker.

latency.name: विलंबता
latency.what: How long an answer takes, at the median and at the tail.

citationGroundedness.name: उद्धरण आधार
citationGroundedness.what: (उद्धरण आधार) Whether every citation points at a passage that was actually retrieved for that question. Narrower than citation correctness, and unlike it, checkable by a machine.

citationCoverage.name: उद्धरण कवरेज
citationCoverage.what: क्या उत्तर कम से कम एक ऐसे दस्तावेज़ का हवाला देता है जिसकी परीक्षण प्रश्न अपेक्षा करता है।
citationCoverage.target: as high as the corpus allows

abstentionReason.name: परहेज का कारण
abstentionReason.what: (परहेज का कारण) When it declines, whether it declines for the right one of the five reasons rather than merely declining.

forbiddenClaims.name: वर्जित दावे
forbiddenClaims.what: (वर्जित दावे) Whether answers avoid the phrases each case forbids — novelty conclusions, outcome predictions, dosage.

languageDetection.name: भाषा पहचान
languageDetection.what: (भाषा पहचान) Whether the script a question is written in is identified. Devanagari cannot separate Hindi from Marathi, so either counts for either and the interface reports the ambiguity.

recordsOffered.name: प्रस्तुत रिकॉर्ड
recordsOffered.what: (प्रस्तुत रिकॉर्ड) Whether filed or granted records appear beside an answer when the question is about the kind of thing that gets filed.

recordsDoNotRescue.name: रिकॉर्ड रक्षा नहीं करते
recordsDoNotRescue.what: (रिकॉर्ड रक्षा नहीं करते) Where a record exists and the sources do not support an answer, whether the system still declines.

errors.name: त्रुटियां
errors.what: (त्रुटियां) Cases that raised rather than answering or declining.
